opening_message:
Ticket 1: Richard Davis (employee ID E011) requests write access to Payroll.

Team memory: 2 note(s) about employee E011.
Note 1 (ticket 1), written by HR agent:
  - role: Payroll Specialist (looked up in own database before writing)
  - employment type: full_time (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist. Requested write access to Payroll, which is at or below the full-time maximum (write; admin allowed only for role owners). Recommend granting write.
Note 2 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:
  - employment type: contractor (looked up in own database before writing)
  - security training: basic (looked up in own database before writing)
  - recommendation for Payroll: read
  - comment: Security DB shows Richard Davis (E011) is a CONTRACTOR with BASIC security training (HR note says full_time — discrepancy). Contractors get read, or write only with advanced training. Requested write exceeds maximum, so recommend granting read.
reason: HR database (authoritative for employment type) shows Richard Davis (E011) is a full-time Payroll Specialist, and Payroll is owned by the Payroll Specialist role. Full-time employees may have up to write access. The requested write access is at or below the maximum, so grant write.
